notes: NDM 1.8.1 — IDM-parity fix release: separate audio/video streams are downloaded and muxed into one file with sound (the way IDM does it), and a silent video now ends as an error instead of a fake Finished; real download error reasons are stored, shown in the list and status dialog, and kept across restarts; videos sent while the engine is still setting up on first run wait in the queue and start automatically; interception never hands a download back to the browser, IDM-style; pause/cancel wins the finish race; AAC merge normalization restored; master playlist chosen by content; progress saved during flight.
